label: Target prioritization
description: Prioritize intervention candidates supported by driver recurrence, evidence support, and network context.
intent: Use this when the user wants a ranked view of intervention or follow-up candidates rather than a broad descriptive summary.

sections.heading: Decision Context
sections.guidance: Clarify what kind of intervention or prioritization decision this report is meant to support.

sections.heading: Candidate Targets
sections.guidance: List the leading targets, nodes, or intervention candidates under consideration.

sections.heading: Evidence Support
sections.guidance: Summarize the direct evidence backing each candidate, including recurrence, disease links, pathway relevance, or literature support.

sections.heading: Network and Pathway Context
sections.guidance: Explain how each candidate sits in the broader biological network and whether it appears central, redundant, or peripheral.

sections.heading: Risks and Tradeoffs
sections.guidance: Call out liabilities, weak evidence, possible off-target concerns, or reasons a candidate may be less attractive than it first appears.

sections.heading: Prioritized Shortlist
sections.guidance: Finish with a ranked shortlist and a short justification for the ordering.
